remarks: A rarely found picture-perfect home situated on 6 acres in a private enclave of 5 luxury homes.  This  one-of-a-kind, custom-designed ranch has stunning curb appeal and a park-like setting.   Built with the finest of amenities and exceptional architectural detail.  Dramatic grand foyer with 25-foot ceiling height. Cased archways and 10” baseboards throughout.  Elegant living/great room with cathedral ceiling and gas fireplace adjoins a  octagonal heated sunroom surrounded by windows for a panoramic view of the landscaped grounds.  Chef’s kitchen has quartz countertops,  island seating, walk-in pantry, flows to bright dining area,  access to a comfy sitting room and 3rd bedroom.  Beautiful primary bedroom ensuite, double tray ceiling, walk-in closet, spa-like bath with oversized walk-in shower, jetted tub.  Vast finished lower level has endless possibilities for use of space. Half bath, workshop, exercise room, cedar and storage closets.  Step onto the spacious patio with a charming gazebo. Custom-built garden shed with loft.  Covered front porch for quiet-time relaxation.  Heated garage is 35’ wide, extra space for lawn equipment, built-in cabinetry, pet wash sink, work bench, private entry to 3rd bedroom. Full house generator.  This meticulously maintained home displays everlasting appeal and shows like new!  Below grade sq. ft. is 3,350.
